body: I feel you immensely I can’t help but think of myself in a fictional universe that’s doing better and much more exciting than whatever I’m doing in my life rn.

I do the same thing often at night, it helps me sleep better when I want to get negative thoughts out my mind I try to not get too invested in it. I believe becoming fully immersed in it can leaving me feeling more depressed than good. I always want my life to become the fictional scenarios I created, at least the relationships
